law.catch_line: The Division and the Program; reports

text.section: The University shall file such reports on the activities of the Division as may be required by law or requested by the Governor.
Virginia State University shall file such reports on the activities of the Program as may be required by law or requested by the Governor.
The University and Virginia State University shall file such reports on the unified plan as may be required by law or requested by the Governor.
